//: Type-checks the shipped registry items (registry/<item>/*.ts) against the workspace packages they import. Not a build — `noEmit`. Run via the root `lint:types:registry` script, which builds all packages first (`build:packages`) so every `@cirrus/*` dist exists regardless of caller. `@cirrus/*` maps to each package's built declarations (not src) so items are checked exactly as a consumer sees them, without recompiling package internals (which would pull Cloudflare-Workers globals from DO-backed packages). `bundler` resolution lets an item's `./schema.js` specifier resolve to its sibling `.ts`.
// exclude: Only cron-registration templates are excluded: they import `./_generated/api`, a *relative* path that exists only after codegen in the user's project and which ambient module declarations cannot stub. (The auth provider snippets import `better-auth`, which IS checkable — it's mapped above to the workspace copy — so they stay in.)
